value_added_per_hour.label: Value added per hour worked, Mainland Norway

productivity.method: TFP is the Solow residual from a Cobb-Douglas production function Y = A K^α L^(1-α) with α = 1/3: log A = log Y − ⅓ log K − ⅔ log L. Y is gross value added in Mainland Norway at constant 2023 prices (SSB 09189), L is total hours worked in Mainland Norway (SSB 09174), K is the net stock of fixed capital in Mainland Norway at constant 2023 prices (SSB 09181). Labour productivity is Y/L. No adjustment is made for capacity utilisation or labour quality. Chain-linked volumes are treated as additive.
